title: One Letter Away From a Mirror
statement:
A word reads the same forwards and backwards if it is a palindrome. You may delete at most one letter of the given word (or none). Can the remaining letters, in their original order, form a palindrome?

## Input
One line containing the word `s`.

## Output
Print `YES` if a palindrome can be obtained by deleting at most one letter, otherwise print `NO`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |s| <= 100000`
- `s` contains only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
